note: This file is a pure configuration file containing only variable assignments (dataset_type, data_root, train_pipeline, test_pipeline, train_dataloader, val_dataloader, test_dataloader, val_evaluator, test_evaluator). It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It is used as a base config for MMDetection Pascal VOC2007+2012 dataset setup.
summarize_voc0712_config: summarize the voc0712 config file that defines train and test pipelines for Pascal VOC dataset
review_voc0712_train_pipeline: review the voc0712 train_pipeline configuration with LoadImageFromFile, LoadAnnotations, Resize, RandomFlip, and PackDetInputs
review_voc0712_test_pipeline: review the voc0712 test_pipeline configuration with LoadImageFromFile, Resize, LoadAnnotations, and PackDetInputs
review_voc0712_train_dataloader: review the voc0712 train_dataloader that concatenates VOC2007 and VOC2012 trainval splits with RepeatDataset
review_voc0712_evaluator: review the voc0712 val_evaluator configured with VOCMetric using mAP and 11points eval mode
